data.one_liner: A fully customizable Google Places autocomplete TextFormField for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized Flutter TextFormField widget that displays address and location autocomplete suggestions directly from the Google Places API. It handles debouncing, API key configuration, country restrictions, and fetching optional place details and coordinates.
use_when: You need an address search input field powered by Google Places
You require customizable UI suggestions within a standard text form field
avoid_when: You are not using the Google Places API
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with forms using a standard TextFormField
Supports web configuration via proxy URL to avoid CORS errors
Allows retrieving lat/lng coordinates and address components directly from predictions
weaknesses: Requires a valid Google Places API key and active network connection
Web platform usage requires a custom proxy URL to handle CORS
data.setup_notes: Requires a Google Places API key. For web builds, a proxy URL must be configured to bypass CORS errors.
